import { LogChannel, type LoggingData } from "@warlock.js/logger";

export class AuditChannel extends LogChannel {
  public name = "audit";

  public log(data: LoggingData) {
    const url = data.context?.request.baseRequest.url;
    const route = data.context?.request.route.path;
    const method = data.context?.request.method;
    const user = data.context?.request.input("userId");
    write({ url, route, method, user, headers: data.context?.request.headers });
  }
}

declare function write(entry: Record<string, unknown>): void;
